design: Two disjoint seed windows; same non-double stone on two legal branch ends, compared high vs low own individually playable tiles; 48 identical conditional hidden worlds per position, identical continuation policy, 60 positions/profile/window.
worldSampling: Uniform conditional on visible stones and observed no-stock passes, ignores prior choice likelihood.
limitations: Exploratory position-cluster intervals, unadjusted for multiplicity
Stratification by next-opponent access is post-action descriptive, not a causal moderator
First-eligible-position discovery, correlated worlds, fixed simple bot policies
Branch-opening semantics provisional, no block winner, finish-first != match win
nextHypothesis: Test whether positions where a higher-own-mobility placement increases opponent next legal access have lower finish-first gain, using a prospectively defined threshold and a third disjoint seed holdout; verify branch semantics against a confirmed human-game fixture before generalizing.
